start.text: It's contained. The attack is stopped, but it is not gone.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. But stopped is not fixed. The site is damaged, the hole is still open, and somebody left a spare key.
A.name: Carla

B.text: A file in the uploads folder, and a new administrator that nobody asked for.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: Walk through the office and look for machines marked with a [b][color=red]![/color][/b]. Restore the site from a clean backup, patch the hole, then remove what was left.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: Yes, the ones whose orders were touched. Plainly, and with what we are doing about it. No panic, no blame.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: Fix one thing at a time. When everything is repaired, we run a [b][color=green]final check[/color][/b].
D.name: Carla

E.text: Got it. Restore the site, patch the hole after a test, and remove the file and the administrator.
E.name: Joshua
